title: Artificial intelligence-enhanced electrocardiography for detection and prediction of dilated cardiomyopathy.

summary: 基于33万余份心电图-超声心动图配对训练深度学习模型，检测并预测扩张型心肌病表型，并在多中心外部队列验证。

abstract: [European heart journal] A major challenge in dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) care is the identification and management of individuals at risk before disease manifestation. An artificial intelligence (AI) model applied to electrocardiography (ECG) was developed to detect and predict the echocardiographic DCM phenotype (left ventricular dilatation with systolic dysfunction) and was evaluated for its ability to stratify the risk of incident DCM in familial cohorts. A deep learning model was trained to detect the echocardiographic DCM phenotype and to predict its future onset, using more than 330 000 ECG-echocardiogram pairs from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston. Model performance was validated in cohorts from the UK Biobank, Zhongshan Hospital, and Antwerp University Hospital, and compared with models based on traditional ECG features and echocardiographic traits. To assess performance in familial DCM, genetically predisposed individuals identified through cascade screening at the cardiogenetics clinics of Antwerp University Hospital (n = 166, 18% DCM positive) and Maastricht University Medical Center (n = 177, 18% DCM positive) were evaluated. The AI-ECG model achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of .87-.97 for diagnosing the prevalent DCM phenotype, outperforming traditional ECG parameters. AI-ECG was comparable to echocardiography for predicting future DCM (C-index .80-.87 and .80-.90, respectively). In familial cohorts, 5-year negative predictive values were 95.5% (Antwerp) and 91.5% (Maastricht), with corresponding positive predictive values of 42.4% and 39.4%, while high-risk scores were associated with a 5.1-6.4-fold increased risk of incident DCM. The explainable AI-ECG model detects the echocardiographic DCM phenotype and predicts future disease, and supports the exclusion of short- to mid-term disease in genetically at-risk individuals. This low-cost tool could help reduce surveillance burden and facilitate earlier intervention.
zh_abstract: [European heart journal] 扩张型心肌病（DCM）诊疗中的一项重大挑战是在疾病表现之前识别和管理处于风险的个体。开发了一种应用于心电图（ECG）的人工智能（AI）模型，用于检测和预测超声心动图DCM表型（左心室扩张伴收缩功能障碍），并评估其在家族性队列中对新发DCM风险进行分层的能力。使用来自波士顿贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心的超过330 000对ECG-超声心动图数据，训练了一个深度学习模型来检测超声心动图DCM表型并预测其未来发生。模型性能在英国生物银行、中山医院和安特卫普大学医院的队列中得到验证，并与基于传统ECG特征和超声心动图特征的模型进行比较。为评估在家族性DCM中的性能，对在安特卫普大学医院心脏遗传学门诊（n = 166，18% DCM阳性）和马斯特里赫特大学医学中心（n = 177，18% DCM阳性）通过级联筛查识别出的遗传易感个体进行了评估。AI-ECG模型在诊断现患DCM表型方面达到0.87–0.97的受试者工作特征曲线下面积，优于传统ECG参数。AI-ECG在预测未来DCM方面与超声心动图相当（C指数分别为0.80–0.87和0.80–0.90）。在家族性队列中，5年阴性预测值分别为95.5%（安特卫普）和91.5%（马斯特里赫特），相应的阳性预测值分别为42.4%和39.4%，而高风险评分与新发DCM风险增加5.1–6.4倍相关。可解释的AI-ECG模型可检测超声心动图DCM表型并预测未来疾病，并支持在遗传高危个体中排除短期至中期疾病。这种低成本工具有助于减轻监测负担并促进更早干预。

title: Personas shift clinical action thresholds in large language models.
zh_title: 人格设定改变大语言模型临床行动阈值
summary: 在事实不变条件下测试九种医生人格提示是否系统性地移动20个开源模型的临床决策阈值。
key_points: 2500份急诊情景+2500份MIMIC出院小结
20个开源模型，共500万次决策
人格提示使行动阈值发生偏移
reason: 大规模模拟实验设计充分，但无真实临床结局验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [npj health systems] Clinical large language model (LLM) deployment is shifting from feasibility to liability, while current guidance largely treats model behavior as a control problem. We tested whether decision-style system prompts shift clinical action thresholds when clinical facts are held constant, and whether these shifts are consistent across settings and models. We defined nine physician personas by crossing three ethical orientations (duty-based, care-based, utilitarian) with three cognitive styles (intuitive, integrative, analytic). Twenty open-weight LLMs were evaluated on 2500 simulated emergency department vignettes and 2500 MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries. For each text, models answered five binary decision items (safety, autonomy, treatment, resource use, follow-up). Each condition was repeated ten times, yielding 5,000,000 total decisions. Under baseline prompting, models answered "Yes" to 42.8% of decisions. Persona prompts shifted affirmative rates from 36.9% to 46.4%, a 9.5 percentage-point swing under fixed clinical evidence. Effects were largest in autonomy and treatment and were consistent across corpora (85.7% directional agreement; r = 0.82 for effect sizes). Susceptibility varied by model (4.9-16.1 points), with no consistent protection from medical fine-tuning or model size. Decision-style system prompts reliably change clinical action thresholds in LLMs under fixed evidence. Prompting is a policy-setting layer, not just a communication layer, and should be treated as a first-class deployment configuration.
zh_abstract: [npj health systems] 临床大语言模型（large language model, LLM）部署正从可行性转向责任风险，而当前指南在很大程度上将模型行为视为控制问题。我们测试了在临床事实保持不变时，决策风格的系统提示是否会改变临床行动阈值，以及这些改变在不同场景和模型间是否一致。我们通过将三种伦理取向（义务论、关怀论、功利主义）与三种认知风格（直觉型、整合型、分析型）交叉，定义了九种医生角色设定。在2500个模拟急诊科案例和2500份MIMIC-IV-Note出院小结上评估了20个开放权重LLM。对于每份文本，模型回答五个二分类决策条目（安全性、自主性、治疗、资源使用、随访）。每种条件重复十次，共产生5,000,000次决策。在基线提示下，模型对42.8%的决策回答“是”。人物设定提示使肯定回答率从36.9%变为46.4%，在固定临床证据下波动9.5个百分点。效应在自主性和治疗方面最大，并在各语料库间一致（方向一致率85.7%；效应量的r = 0.82）。易感性因模型而异（4.9-16.1个百分点），医学微调或模型规模未提供一致的保护。在固定证据下，决策风格系统提示可靠地改变LLM的临床行动阈值。提示是一个政策设定层，而不仅仅是沟通层，应被视为一等部署配置。

title: Performance of a Large Language Model for Predicting Clinical and Radiographic Outcomes in Knee Osteoarthritis: Single-Center Prospective Observational Study.

abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Large language models (LLMs) can extract information from unstructured clinical text, but it remains unclear whether their ability to assess current status translates into reliable predictions of longitudinal outcomes. This study aimed to evaluate DeepSeek's ability to assess baseline clinical and radiographic status in knee osteoarthritis (KOA), its performance in predicting 6-month outcomes, and its interrun reproducibility. This study used a single-center, prospective observational cohort design to conduct a blinded, retrospective evaluation of the LLM. A total of 128 patients with primary KOA were enrolled, of whom 111 (86.7%) completed the 6-month follow-up and were included in the primary analysis. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and a rheumatologist independently assessed KOA diagnoses, baseline Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index (WOMAC) scores, and Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grading based on the same standardized interview records and imaging reports and predicted 6-month outcomes. The LLM was run independently 3 times. The actual outcomes determined by another senior physician served as the reference, and the results were compared with the physician's predictions and the persistence model. The LLM showed high baseline diagnostic agreement with the physician (105/111, 94.6%) and good agreement on the WOMAC and KL, but 6-month predictions (WOMAC mean absolute error=5.92-6.58; KL exact agreement=74/111, 66.7%-76/111, 68.5%) were worse than those of the physician comparator (mean absolute error=3.86; 96/111, 86.5%) and not superior to those of the persistence model (mean absolute error=5.43). Despite high interrun intraclass correlation coefficients (0.982 and 0.965), exact agreement between runs was poor (35/111, 31.5% and 7/111, 6.3%). The evaluated DeepSeek configuration may support structured baseline KOA assessment. However, its 6-month predictive accuracy and patient-level stability remain limited. Prognostic applications require evidence of added value over a persistence model.
zh_abstract: [JMIR Medical Informatics] 大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）可从非结构化临床文本中提取信息，但其评估当前状态的能力是否能转化为对纵向结局的可靠预测仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估DeepSeek在膝骨关节炎（knee osteoarthritis, KOA）中评估基线临床和影像学状态的能力、其预测6个月结局的表现，以及其运行间可重复性。本研究采用单中心、前瞻性观察队列设计，对LLM进行盲法、回顾性评估。共纳入128例原发性KOA患者，其中111例（86.7%）完成了6个月随访并纳入主要分析。DeepSeek-V4-Flash和一名风湿科医师基于相同的标准化访谈记录和影像报告，独立评估KOA诊断、基线西安大略和麦克马斯特大学骨关节炎指数（Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index, WOMAC）评分和Kellgren-Lawrence（KL）分级，并预测6个月结局。LLM独立运行3次。由另一名资深医师确定的实际结局作为参考，并将结果与医师的预测和持续性模型进行比较。LLM在基线诊断上与医师高度一致（105/111，94.6%），在WOMAC和KL上也具有良好一致性，但6个月预测（WOMAC平均绝对误差=5.92-6.58；KL完全一致=74/111，66.7%-76/111，68.5%）劣于医师对照者（平均绝对误差=3.86；96/111，86.5%），且不优于持续性模型（平均绝对误差=5.43）。尽管运行间组内相关系数较高（0.982和0.965），但运行间完全一致率较差（35/111，31.5%和7/111，6.3%）。所评估的DeepSeek配置可能支持结构化的基线KOA评估。然而，其6个月预测准确性和患者层面稳定性仍然有限。预后应用需要证明其相对于持续性模型的附加价值。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Colorectal Cancer Diagnosis: A Comprehensive Survey of Modalities, Frameworks, and Clinical Tasks.
zh_title: AI用于结直肠癌诊断的综合综述

abstract: [Cancers] The diagnosis of colorectal cancer encompasses nine complementary modalities: stool-based screening, blood-based biomarkers, cross-sectional imaging, endoscopic evaluation, histopathology, liquid biopsy, molecular and genetic profiling, microbiome analysis, and nanotechnology-based diagnostics. This narrative review synthesizes 160 references spanning seven task-specific artificial intelligence domains, including computer-aided detection, optical diagnosis, invasion depth prediction, computational pathology and radiogenomics, metastasis forecasting, neoadjuvant treatment response prediction, and surgical workflow analysis. We propose a conceptual multimodal pipeline comprising data ingestion, preprocessing and harmonization, feature representation, multimodal fusion, forecasting, explainability, and validation. A structured evidence grading framework classifies each clinical task by evidence level, consistency, and clinical readiness. We further catalog public datasets, challenge benchmarks, and five reporting standards: TRIPOD-AI, CONSORT-AI, SPIRIT-AI, DECIDE-AI, and CLAIM. Computer-aided detection and optical diagnosis demonstrate the highest maturity with Level 1 evidence from randomized controlled trials, while computational pathology, radiogenomics, and metastasis prediction remain at Level 2 with retrospective validation (internal or external). Microbiome screening, nanotechnology diagnostics, and surgical phase recognition are exploratory. The principal barriers to clinical adoption are domain shift, data scarcity, calibration, prospective validation, and workflow integration. We conclude that clinically useful artificial intelligence requires robust external validation, uncertainty quantification, explainable outputs, standardized reporting, and a structured translational pathway from retrospective evidence through regulatory clearance to post-deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: [Cancers] 结直肠癌的诊断涵盖九种互补模式：基于粪便的筛查、基于血液的生物标志物、横断面成像、内镜评估、组织病理学、液体活检、分子与遗传分析、微生物组分析以及基于纳米技术的诊断。本叙述性综述综合了160篇参考文献，涵盖七个任务特定的人工智能领域，包括计算机辅助检测、光学诊断、浸润深度预测、计算病理学与放射基因组学、转移预测、新辅助治疗反应预测以及手术工作流程分析。我们提出一个概念性多模态流程，包括数据摄取、预处理与协调、特征表示、多模态融合、预测、可解释性和验证。一个结构化的证据分级框架根据证据级别、一致性和临床就绪度对每项临床任务进行分类。我们进一步编目了公共数据集、挑战基准和五项报告标准：TRIPOD-AI、CONSORT-AI、SPIRIT-AI、DECIDE-AI 和 CLAIM。计算机辅助检测和光学诊断成熟度最高，具有来自随机对照试验的1级证据，而计算病理学、放射基因组学和转移预测仍处于2级，采用回顾性验证（内部或外部）。微生物组筛查、纳米技术诊断和手术阶段识别属于探索性。临床采用的主要障碍是域偏移、数据稀缺、校准、前瞻性验证和工作流程整合。我们得出结论，临床有用的人工智能需要稳健的外部验证、不确定性量化、可解释输出、标准化报告，以及从回顾性证据到监管许可再到部署后监测的结构化转化路径。

abstract: [Journal of computer-aided molecular design] AI models such as foundation models and generative models have shown promise for aiding drug discovery alongside traditional cheminformatics and bioinformatics tools and physics-based approaches. In this study, we design a workflow that integrates these AI methods to generate molecules alongside established informatic and predictive filtering approaches to streamline downselection of molecules from the massive and noisy result sets generated by AI. This workflow evaluates generative methods based on validity, reliability, diversity, similarity, hallucination and campaign needs. Analyses are made on the original proprietary dataset to determine molecular property thresholds for screening criteria. Overall, 249 molecules are selected from ~ 5 million generated molecules. 18 molecules are then validated with free energy perturbation simulations. 5 out of 5 retain on target inhibition, with IC50 values below 1 μM. 1 of the 5 experimentally validated molecules displayed greater inhibition than the corresponding lead molecule. Predictive foundation model MMELON yields Pearson correlation R = 0.72 in blind test, showing potential for future drug discovery campaigns.
zh_abstract: [Journal of computer-aided molecular design] 基础模型和生成模型等AI模型已显示出辅助药物发现的潜力，可与传统化学信息学和生物信息学工具以及基于物理的方法并用。在本研究中，我们设计了一个工作流程，将这些AI方法与成熟的信息学和预测性过滤方法整合，以从AI生成的大规模且嘈杂的结果集中简化分子筛选。该工作流程基于有效性、可靠性、多样性、相似性、幻觉和药物发现项目需求评估生成方法。在原始专有数据集上进行分析，以确定筛选标准的分子性质阈值。总体而言，从约500万个生成分子中选出249个分子。随后用自由能微扰（free energy perturbation）模拟验证18个分子。5个中有5个保留靶点抑制作用，IC50值低于1 μM。在5个经实验验证的分子中，有1个显示出比相应先导分子更强的抑制作用。预测性基础模型MMELON在盲测中产生Pearson相关系数R = 0.72，显示出用于未来药物发现项目的潜力。

abstract: [Thyroid : official journal of the American Thyroid Association] Differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) generally carries an excellent prognosis, yet recurrence occurs in up to 8-9% of patients. Artificial intelligence (AI) models are increasingly proposed to predict DTC recurrence; however, their methodological quality and clinical readiness are poorly defined. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the methodological quality, risk of bias, and applicability of these models using the PROBAST + AI framework. We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane databases, Scopus, and Web of Science from inception to July 13, 2026. Eligible studies included original research developing or validating AI models for recurrence in DTC. Model quality (for development), risk of bias (for evaluation), and applicability were assessed using the PROBAST + AI framework, with a focus on discrimination, calibration, and validation strategies (PROSPERO; registration number [CRD420251004644]). Of 673 records screened, 34 studies were included (21 unique datasets and 13 UCI-derived publications), encompassing 21,267 patients with a recurrence rate of 7.8%. Most were developed in Asian cohorts (17 of 21 datasets) and were structured clinical/tabular variables (82.4%), including demographic, clinical, laboratory, and pathological data, whereas the remaining models incorporated multimodal inputs such as imaging-derived or radiomic features. Notably, nearly one quarter of included studies (13 of 34, 38%) represented reanalysis of a single dataset. Discrimination was reported in 22 of 34 studies (64.7%) (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC] 0.67-1.00), though only 10 studies assessed calibration, none with standardized metrics. The PROBAST + AI assessment revealed high overall quality concerns in 26 of 34 (76.5%) development studies due to reliance on single-center cohorts, inadequate handling of missing data, and absence of external validation. Only 6 of 34 included studies (17.6%) were judged to have low overall quality concern, whereas 17 of 34 (50.0%) were rated as having low applicability concern. AI models for predicting DTC recurrence show promising discriminatory performance but have substantial methodological shortcomings in development, and a lack of calibration and external validation necessary for clinical use. Given the guidelines' emphasis on risk-adapted de-escalation of therapy, the development of robust, validated, and clinically calibrated AI tools is a priority. Materials and Methods: Using the MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD databases we developed and applied a configurable pipeline (medalabel) that stepwise maps the databases into the OMOP Common Data Model, standardizes and cleans the data, and preprocesses them to compute Sepsis-3 labels. On fixed cohorts of first ICU stays (13,388 in MIMIC-III, 94,782 in eICU-CRD), we changed one setting of a reference configuration at a time (51 variants in five preprocessing domains) and compared detection rates and septic stays (Jaccard index) with the reference. The time a value is measured can differ from the time it is documented and thus available for automated analysis. zh_abstract: 【目的】已发表的 Sepsis-3 检出率在 MIMIC-III 中范围为 3.4% 至 65.2%，在 eICU-CRD 中为 9.8% 至 47.9%。我们在数据、队列和脓毒症定义保持不变的情况下，检验了仅数据预处理决策是否会产生这种量级的差异。【材料与方法】使用 MIMIC-III 和 eICU-CRD 数据库，我们开发并应用了一个可配置流程（medalabel），该流程逐步将数据库映射到 OMOP 通用数据模型（OMOP Common Data Model），标准化和清理数据，并对数据进行预处理以计算 Sepsis-3 标签。预处理的每个设置代表已发表 Sepsis-3 实现中的一项决策，设置可以自由组合。在固定的首次 ICU 入住队列中（MIMIC-III 为 13,388 例，eICU-CRD 为 94,782 例），我们每次改变参考配置的一个设置（五个预处理域中的 51 个变体），并将检出率和脓毒症入住记录（Jaccard 指数）与参考配置进行比较。我们近似重建了六个已发表流程，并将效应最大的设置成对组合，以检验其效应是否相加。一个数值被测量的时间可能不同于其被记录并因而可用于自动化分析的时间。除基于测量时间的常规回顾性视角外，该流程还可选地结合两个时间点，以模拟实时系统。【结果】参考配置在 MIMIC-III 中将 31.5% 的 ICU 入住记录标记为脓毒症，在 eICU-CRD 中为 8.2%。改变单一设置导致脓毒症检出率在 MIMIC-III 中为 15.3–58.6%，在 eICU-CRD 中为 4.6–17.2%。与参考配置相比的最大偏移在两个数据库中方向均一致，来自 SOFA 基线（MIMIC-III 中高达 +27.1 个百分点（pp），eICU-CRD 中 +9.0 pp）、禁用插补（-16.3 和 -2.5 pp）、时间窗（+12.6 和 +5.3 pp）和聚合（-10.1 和 -0.8 pp）；临床医生验证的参数集影响很小（-4.8 和 -1.1 pp）。即使是将率改变小于 2 pp 的变体，也标记了部分不同的患者，Jaccard 指数在 MIMIC-III 中低至 0.67，在 eICU-CRD 中低至 0.56（1 = 脓毒症入住记录完全相同）。重建结果与已发表率相差 2–10 pp。同时应用两项设置时，其结果与各自单一效应之和相差在 MIMIC-III 中为 0.9–11.8 pp，在 eICU-CRD 中最高达 4.9 pp。模拟实时系统使 MIMIC-III 的率降低 5.0 pp，并在仍为脓毒症的入住记录中使 45% 的标签延迟。【讨论】

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Valvular heart disease (VHD) affects a substantial proportion of the population and remains a major cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality worldwide. Despite advances in surgical and transcatheter therapies, important challenges persist. VHD remains underdiagnosed, assessment of disease severity is often variable, and the optimal timing of intervention continues to evolve. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool across the spectrum of VHD care. AI-based electrocardiogram analysis can identify both existing and future VHD, while AI-guided point-of-care ultrasound extends screening to nonspecialist settings. Across multimodality imaging, machine learning (ML) and deep learning algorithms enable automated, reproducible assessment of VHD. In echocardiography, AI supports grading of disease severity across the main valvular lesions, including Doppler interpretation and automated report generation. AI-enhanced cardiac magnetic resonance facilitates automated assessment of ventricular remodeling and myocardial fibrosis, while AI-assisted cardiac computed tomography improves procedural planning for transcatheter interventions. In parallel, ML has identified distinct patient phenotypes in multiple valvular lesions with differing clinical trajectories and responses to intervention. This review summarizes current applications of AI in detection, multimodality imaging, and potential clinical decision support for VHD and discusses opportunities and challenges for integration into routine practice.
zh_abstract: [Methodist DeBakey 心血管杂志] 瓣膜性心脏病（VHD）影响相当大比例的人群，并且仍然是全球心血管疾病发病和死亡的主要原因。尽管外科和经导管治疗取得了进展，但重要挑战仍然存在。VHD 仍存在诊断不足，疾病严重程度的评估常常不一致，最佳干预时机仍在不断演变。人工智能（AI）已成为贯穿 VHD 诊疗全谱的有前景工具。基于 AI 的心电图分析可以识别现有和未来的 VHD，而 AI 引导的床旁超声将筛查扩展到非专科环境。在多模态影像中，机器学习（ML）和深度学习算法能够实现对 VHD 的自动化、可重复评估。在超声心动图中，AI 支持对主要瓣膜病变的疾病严重程度进行分级，包括多普勒解读和自动报告生成。AI 增强的心脏磁共振有助于自动评估心室重构和心肌纤维化，而 AI 辅助的心脏计算机断层扫描可改善经导管干预的操作规划。与此同时，ML 已在多种瓣膜病变中识别出具有不同临床轨迹和干预反应的不同患者表型。本综述总结了 AI 在 VHD 检测、多模态影像和潜在临床决策支持中的当前应用，并讨论了将其整合到常规实践中的机遇和挑战。

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Aortic disease and lower-extremity peripheral artery disease (PAD) generate substantial morbidity, mortality, and longitudinal imaging burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly studied for vascular risk prediction, image analysis, procedural support, and surveillance, but the maturity of these applications is heterogeneous. This review evaluates recent AI applications in aortic disease and PAD, emphasizing the distinction between algorithmic performance, external validation, demonstrated workflow impact, and proven patient benefit. Automated image segmentation and opportunistic abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) detection have the most mature evidence base, including retrospective external validation and, for AI-assisted AAA case finding, nonrandomized evidence of improved downstream evaluation and follow-up. Conversely, while machine-learning models for vascular risk prediction and disease progression often report high retrospective accuracy, their clinical readiness remains strictly investigational. Across most aortic and PAD applications, there is a persistent lack of independent external validation, decision-curve analysis, and prospective testing against standard care. Image-fusion guidance has clinical evidence for reducing procedural resource use, but this evidence should not be conflated with autonomous AI or robotic navigation. Cardiovascular digital twins remain largely mechanistic, computational, or early-development frameworks. AI can augment vascular imaging and risk assessment, but high retrospective accuracy is not equivalent to clinical utility. Current guideline thresholds for repair, revascularization, and surveillance should not be altered on the basis of investigational radiomics or prediction models. Translation requires multicenter external validation, prospective workflow evaluation, calibration and net-benefit assessment, transparent reporting, and trials demonstrating improved patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] 主动脉疾病和下肢外周动脉疾病（peripheral artery disease, PAD）造成显著的发病率、死亡率和纵向影像负担。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在血管风险预测、图像分析、操作支持和监测方面的研究日益增多，但这些应用的成熟度参差不齐。本综述评估主动脉疾病和PAD中近期AI应用，强调区分算法性能、外部验证、已证实的工作流程影响和已证实的患者获益。自动图像分割和机会性腹主动脉瘤（abdominal aortic aneurysm, AAA）检测具有最成熟的证据基础，包括回顾性外部验证，以及对于AI辅助AAA病例发现，有非随机证据表明下游评估和随访得到改善。相反，尽管用于血管风险预测和疾病进展的机器学习模型常报告较高的回顾性准确度，但其临床就绪度仍严格处于研究阶段。在大多数主动脉和PAD应用中，持续缺乏独立外部验证、决策曲线分析以及针对标准诊疗的前瞻性测试。图像融合引导有临床证据表明可减少操作资源使用，但该证据不应与自主AI或机器人导航混为一谈。心血管数字孪生在很大程度上仍属于机制性、计算性或早期开发框架。AI可增强血管影像和风险评估，但高回顾性准确度并不等同于临床效用。不应基于研究性放射组学或预测模型改变当前指南中关于修复、血运重建和监测的阈值。转化需要多中心外部验证、前瞻性工作流程评估、校准和净获益评估、透明报告，以及证明患者结局改善的试验。

title: X-Strata: Separating Aneurysms and Overlapping Vessels into Layers from 2D X-ray Angiography

abstract: An X-ray angiogram sums every structure along a ray into one pixel. When vessels cross an aneurysm, they obscure part of it and mix their contrast into its filling curve. We present X-Strata, a network that separates a cine angiogram into three layers: the complete aneurysm sac, the vessels in front of it, and the vessels behind it. Contrast timing indicates how much each layer contributes to a pixel, and parallax between two views indicates their order, which a single view cannot determine. X-Strata first estimates the layers and their contrast curves, then uses the second view to assign vessels to the front or back layer, and lifts all layers into 3D. It learns from layer labels projected from same-session 3D rotational angiography, but needs only 2D cine runs and their acquisition geometry at inference. On 220 held-out patients from three centers (122 external), two-view X-Strata ranks first among 14 baselines, including VGGT and C$^2$RV, in recovering the sac where vessels overlap it (Dice 0.693 internal, 0.641 external) and in ordering the layers (balanced accuracy 0.703, 0.659). Its order accuracy exceeds that of all 11 end-to-end baselines by at least 4.1 points internally and 3.3 externally (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$) and grows with view separation. Recovered 3D sac surfaces have a median Chamfer distance of 0.34 mm on the internal cohort. X-Strata may therefore provide layered aneurysm and vessel information, including 3D sac shape, for patients who undergo only 2D angiography.
zh_abstract: X线血管造影将沿一条射线的每个结构叠加至一个像素中。当血管跨越动脉瘤时，会遮挡其一部分，并将其对比剂信号混入动脉瘤的充盈曲线。我们提出X-Strata，一种将电影血管造影分离为三层的网络：完整动脉瘤囊、位于其前方的血管以及位于其后方的血管。对比剂时序指示各层对像素的贡献程度，而两个视图之间的视差指示其前后顺序，这是单视图无法确定的。X-Strata首先估计各层及其对比剂曲线，然后利用第二个视图将血管分配至前层或后层，并将所有层提升至三维。它从同次检查的三维旋转血管造影投影得到的层面标签中学习，但在推理时仅需二维电影血管造影序列及其采集几何信息。在来自三个中心的220例留出患者（其中122例为外部）中，双视图X-Strata在血管与囊重叠处恢复囊体（Dice内部0.693，外部0.641）以及对层进行排序（平衡准确率0.703、0.659）方面，在包括VGGT和C$^2$RV在内的14个基线中排名第一。其顺序准确率在内部至少超过所有11个端到端基线4.1个百分点，在外部至少超过3.3个百分点（Holm校正后$p < 0.001$），并随视图间隔增大而提高。恢复的三维囊体表面在内部队列上的中位Chamfer距离为0.34 mm。因此，X-Strata或可为仅接受二维血管造影的患者提供分层的动脉瘤和血管信息，包括三维囊体形状。

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering routine care through documentation tools, decision support, and hospital operations. The central question is whether these systems improve clinical work and patient care once embedded in routine workflows, not only whether they perform well on test data. This targeted narrative review follows AI from voice dictation and ambient documentation to operating room (OR) organization, using hysteroscopy as a clinical exemplar of the transition from technical performance to clinical utility. Evidence identified through targeted searches completed on 6 September 2026 was appraised with a framework that distinguishes image-level from patient-level results, internal from independent validation, and discrimination from clinical utility. Randomized trials and multisite observational data show modest, product-dependent benefits of clinician-reviewed ambient documentation; inaccuracies persist. Evidence for patient-message drafting derives from ratings of responses to public-forum questions and supports only bounded, supervised feasibility testing. In hysteroscopy, selected models discriminate well in narrowly defined tasks, but most studies are retrospective, image-level, or internally validated, and patient-level errors in high-risk categories are seldom reported. Reported gains in OR scheduling come largely from simulation. Safe implementation requires a defined clinical need, baseline measurement, subgroup-aware local validation, accountable review, and predefined criteria for expansion or withdrawal.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 人工智能（AI）正通过文档工具、决策支持和医院运营进入常规诊疗。核心问题在于，这些系统一旦嵌入常规工作流程，是否改善临床工作和患者照护，而不仅仅是它们在测试数据上表现良好。本针对性叙述性综述追踪AI从语音听写到环境文档再到手术室（OR）组织的过程，并以宫腔镜作为从技术性能向临床效用转化的临床范例。通过于2026年9月6日完成的针对性检索所识别的证据，采用一个区分图像层面与患者层面结果、内部验证与独立验证、以及区分能力与临床效用的框架进行评价。随机试验和多站点观察数据显示，经临床医生审核的环境文档具有适度且因产品而异的好处；不准确之处仍然存在。患者信息草拟的证据来自对公共论坛问题回答的评分，仅支持有边界的、有监督的可行性测试。在宫腔镜中，选定模型在狭义定义的任务中区分良好，但大多数研究是回顾性的、图像层面的或内部验证的，并且高风险类别中的患者层面错误很少被报告。所报告的手术室排程改善主要来自模拟。安全实施需要明确的临床需求、基线测量、考虑亚组的本地验证、可问责的审查，以及预先定义的扩展或退出标准。

abstract: AbstractAI is often framed as a threat to medical education owing to concerns it may diminish the cognitive struggle through which trainees traditionally develop clinical judgment - a legitimate but incomplete concern. Medicine has never been defined by unaided human cognition; it has been defined by the obligation to use the best available tools in the service of patients. As AI systems increasingly extend not only clinicians' perception, but also their reasoning, medical mastery may shift from memorization and independent synthesis toward the orchestration, supervision, and calibrated deference to intelligent systems. The task for medical education is therefore not to preserve cognitive struggle for its own sake, but to refocus it from recalling facts to interrogating machine reasoning, detecting failure modes, and knowing when human intervention improves care versus when it merely interrupts a better system.
zh_abstract: 摘要：人工智能常被描述为对医学教育的威胁，因为人们担心它可能削弱学员传统上借以发展临床判断力的认知挣扎——这是一种合理但不完整的担忧。医学从来不是由无辅助的人类认知所定义的；它是由为患者服务而使用最佳可用工具的义务所定义的。随着人工智能系统日益不仅扩展临床医生的感知，也扩展其推理，医学精通可能从记忆和独立综合转向对智能系统的统筹协调、监督以及有校准的遵从。因此，医学教育的任务不是为认知挣扎本身而保留它，而是将其重点从回忆事实转向质询机器推理、检测失效模式，并知道何时人类干预能改善照护，何时它只是打断了一个更好的系统。

abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] Craniosynostosis, the premature fusion of cranial sutures, can cause abnormal skull shapes, neurological issues and aesthetic concerns. Surgical correction is standard, but planning is complex and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers the potential to enhance diagnosis, optimise planning and predict postoperative outcomes. A scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines identified 11 studies involving paediatric patients with craniosynostosis. AI methods included unsupervised machine learning, convolutional neural networks, finite element models and variational autoencoders. Applications encompassed cranial severity scoring, phenotype classification, preoperative surgical simulation, intraoperative guidance and outcome prediction. AI-derived metrics correlated strongly with expert assessments, facilitated patient-specific planning and predicted postoperative aesthetics. AI is a transformative adjunct in craniosynostosis surgery. Clinically, it improves diagnostic accuracy, supports personalised surgical planning and guides intraoperative decision-making. Some studies show AI can contribute to better functional and aesthetic outcomes, showing great promise in the paediatric surgical field. Although AI does not replace clinical expertise, it enhances precision and reproducibility. Future research should prioritise prospective validation, integration into surgical workflows and development of interpretable, surgeon-friendly AI tools to maximise clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [ANZ 外科杂志] 颅缝早闭，即颅缝过早融合，可导致颅骨形状异常、神经系统问题和美学顾虑。手术矫正是标准治疗，但规划复杂且依赖操作者。人工智能（AI）具有增强诊断、优化规划和预测术后结局的潜力。一项遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南的范围综述识别了 11 项涉及颅缝早闭儿科患者的研究。AI 方法包括无监督机器学习、卷积神经网络、有限元模型和变分自编码器。应用涵盖颅骨严重程度评分、表型分类、术前手术模拟、术中引导和结局预测。AI 衍生的指标与专家评估强相关，促进了患者特异性规划，并预测了术后美学。AI 是颅缝早闭手术中的变革性辅助手段。在临床上，它提高诊断准确性、支持个性化手术规划并指导术中决策。一些研究表明，AI 可有助于获得更好的功能和美学结局，在儿科外科领域显示出巨大前景。尽管 AI 不能替代临床专业知识，但它提高了精确性和可重复性。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性验证、整合到手术工作流程中，并开发可解释、外科医生友好的 AI 工具，以最大化临床获益。

abstract: [Advanced drug delivery reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is advancing nanomedicine development by linking formulation variables and biological context with delivery, therapeutic efficacy, and safety. This review examines AI assisted formulation design, centralized formulation databases, prediction of nanoparticle self assembly, and models of cell and tissue selective delivery, biodistribution, and therapeutic outcomes. Recent advances in predicting nanotoxicity and nanoparticle induced immune responses further emphasize the importance of incorporating safety endpoints into nanomedicine optimization. Beyond nanocarrier engineering, foundation models and multimodal analyses of single-cell and spatial data are expanding biological discovery by characterizing disease associated cellular states, prioritizing therapeutic targets, and predicting treatment responses. Computational approaches also support the design of therapeutic RNA, peptides, proteins, and programmable protein nanomaterials. For example, mRNA sequences generated by GEMORNA and delivered via lipid nanoparticles increased erythropoietin expression in mice by up to 15-fold compared with a benchmark sequence. Integration of biological discovery with biomolecular and nanocarrier design may inform therapeutic cargo selection, targeting strategies, and functional nanomaterial development. AI may connect patient specific biological characteristics with predictions of nanomedicine delivery and therapeutic response to support patient stratification and individualized treatment selection. Integration of histological, imaging, molecular, and longitudinal data may enable treatment strategies to be adapted to differences in tissue characteristics, disease state, and therapeutic response. Emerging approaches based on digital twins and adaptive treatment control may extend the framework toward individualized dosing and dynamic treatment optimization. Major challenges include data heterogeneity, limited model generalizability, and the need for experimental and prospective validation. Progress toward precision therapy will require integrated frameworks that jointly consider delivery, efficacy, selectivity, and safety while clearly distinguishing demonstrated applications from future opportunities.
zh_abstract: [Advanced drug delivery reviews] 人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）正在通过将制剂变量和生物学背景与递送、治疗疗效和安全性联系起来，推动纳米医学发展。本综述考察了AI辅助的制剂设计、集中式制剂数据库、纳米颗粒自组装的预测，以及细胞和组织选择性递送、生物分布和治疗结局的模型。在预测纳米毒性和纳米颗粒诱导的免疫反应方面的最新进展，进一步强调了将安全性终点纳入纳米医学优化的重要性。除纳米载体工程外，基础模型以及对单细胞和空间数据的多模态分析正在扩展生物学发现，具体包括表征疾病相关细胞状态、优先确定治疗靶点以及预测治疗反应。计算方法还支持治疗性RNA、肽、蛋白质和可编程蛋白质纳米材料的设计。例如，由GEMORNA生成并通过脂质纳米颗粒递送的mRNA序列，与基准序列相比，使小鼠中促红细胞生成素表达增加多达15倍。将生物学发现与生物分子和纳米载体设计相结合，可能为治疗性载荷选择、靶向策略和功能性纳米材料开发提供信息。AI可能将患者特异性生物学特征与纳米医学递送和治疗反应的预测联系起来，以支持患者分层和个体化治疗选择。整合组织学、影像学、分子和纵向数据，可能使治疗策略能够适应组织特征、疾病状态和治疗反应的差异。基于数字孪生和适应性治疗控制的新兴方法可能将该框架扩展到个体化给药和动态治疗优化。主要挑战包括数据异质性、模型泛化性有限，以及需要实验性和前瞻性验证。朝着精准治疗取得进展将需要整合框架，共同考虑递送、疗效、选择性和安全性，同时清楚区分已证明的应用与未来机会。

abstract: [Artificial organs] Achieving tight glycemic control in Type 1 diabetes is challenged by non-linear metabolic dynamics and insulin-stacking risk. Artificial intelligence models offer improved personalization, but their opacity raises safety concerns, particularly for basal insulin dosing, which is often treated as static in existing decision-support systems. We propose a hybrid closed-loop system combining a data-driven LightGBM regressor for basal dose prediction, trained on the T1D-UOM dataset, with a physiologically grounded, rule-based safety layer at the edge. Basal insulin is predicted from cyclical time encoding and glucose rate-of-change; bolus dosing follows carbohydrate intake and correction requirements. A time-bounded insulin-on-board model, an uncertainty-adaptive post-bolus damping factor, and a predictive low-glucose-suspend rule reproducing the Tandem Basal-IQ protocol together suspend or reduce delivery when residual insulin is high or hypoglycemia is projected. The system was evaluated in silico over 60 continuous days under shadow-mode replay and closed-loop reduced-order simulation, including an ablation with bolus delivery suppressed. Under chronological, within-subject validation, the offline basal estimator achieved R 2 = 0.68 and MAE = 0.21 U; under strict leave-one-subject-out validation on the same real cohort, performance did not generalize to unseen subjects ( R 2 = - 0.49 , MAE = 0.49 U). The hybrid controller maintained Time-in-Range at 62.8% within the reduced-order closed-loop simulation, with no violations of the insulin-on-board suspension or damping rules; suppressing bolus delivery in an ablation within this simulation dropped Time-in-Range to 26.1%, indicating that, within the reduced-order model, bolus delivery is a determinant of simulated glycemic outcome. The proposed architecture demonstrates a safety-audited template for combining machine-learning basal prediction with clinically grounded dosing rules. Validation on real outcome data and physical hardware is identified as the next steps toward clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Artificial organs] 在1型糖尿病中实现严格血糖控制受到非线性代谢动力学和胰岛素堆积风险的挑战。人工智能模型可提供更好的个体化，但其不透明性引发安全性担忧，尤其是基础胰岛素给药，在现有决策支持系统中常被视为静态。我们提出一种混合闭环系统，将基于数据驱动的LightGBM回归器用于基础剂量预测（在T1D-UOM数据集上训练），与位于边缘端的、基于生理学的规则式安全层相结合。基础胰岛素根据周期性时间编码和葡萄糖变化率进行预测；大剂量给药遵循碳水化合物摄入和校正需求。一个有界时间的胰岛素在体模型、一个不确定性自适应的餐后大剂量阻尼因子，以及一条复现Tandem Basal-IQ方案的预测性低血糖暂停规则，共同在残余胰岛素较高或预测低血糖时暂停或减少输注。该系统在60个连续日的计算机模拟中，通过影子模式回放和闭环降阶仿真进行评估，包括抑制大剂量给药的消融。在按时间顺序的受试者内验证中，离线基础估计器达到R 2 = 0.68和MAE = 0.21 U；在同一真实队列的严格留一受试者交叉验证中，性能未能泛化到未见受试者（R 2 = - 0.49，MAE = 0.49 U）。混合控制器在降阶闭环仿真中将范围内时间（Time-in-Range）维持在62.8%，未违反胰岛素在体暂停或阻尼规则；在该仿真中通过消融抑制大剂量给药使范围内时间降至26.1%，表明在降阶模型内，大剂量给药是模拟血糖结局的决定因素。所提出的架构展示了一个经过安全性审计的模板，用于将机器学习基础预测与有临床依据的给药规则相结合。在真实结局数据和物理硬件上的验证被确定为迈向临床转化的下一步。

However, reported model performance varies substantially across clinical domains, and high predictive performance does not necessarily demonstrate clinical utility or readiness for deployment. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on the applications of AI in nephrology and critically evaluates the methodological maturity, validation, interpretability, fairness, and translational readiness of AI systems across major nephrology domains. A structured literature search of PubMed was conducted using terms related to AI and nephrology, with the primary eligibility period restricted to studies published from 2020 to 2025. The search strategy incorporated artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, natural language processing, large language models, generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, federated learning, and related terms, together with nephrology and kidney-disease terms. Title/abstract and full-text screening were performed independently by the first and second authors, with disagreements resolved by the third author. Two foundational pre-2020 studies identified through citation chaining were retained because of their importance to the subsequent development of AI applications in nephrology. External validation was present for some applications, whereas prospective evaluation and evidence of clinical utility remained limited. The literature also highlighted challenges related to calibration, generalizability, interpretability, algorithmic fairness, data governance, and integration into clinical workflows. zh_abstract: [Frontiers in nephrology] 人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）正越来越多地应用于肾脏病学领域，其潜在应用涵盖疾病预测、诊断、治疗优化和临床决策支持。然而，所报告的模型性能在不同临床领域之间差异很大，且高预测性能并不一定证明临床实用性或部署准备就绪。本叙述性综述综合了关于AI在肾脏病学中应用的当前证据，并批判性评估了主要肾脏病学领域中AI系统的方法学成熟度、验证、可解释性、公平性和转化准备度。使用与AI和肾脏病学相关的术语对PubMed进行了结构化文献检索，主要纳入期限限制为2020年至2025年发表的研究。检索策略纳入了人工智能、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络、自然语言处理、大语言模型、生成式AI、计算机视觉、强化学习、联邦学习及相关术语，并结合肾脏病学和肾脏疾病术语。标题/摘要和全文筛选由第一作者和第二作者独立进行，分歧由第三作者解决。通过引文追溯识别出的两项2020年前基础性研究因对肾脏病学中AI应用的后续发展具有重要意义而被保留。证据根据研究设计、验证、预测性能、可解释性、公平性、前瞻性评估和转化准备度进行定性综合。在急性肾损伤、慢性肾脏病、肾脏病理学、肾移植、血液透析、腹膜透析、大语言模型、强化学习和联邦学习中识别了AI应用。在这些领域中，许多模型表现出有前景的判别能力，但证据成熟度差异很大。一些应用已有外部验证，而前瞻性评估和临床实用性证据仍然有限。文献还强调了与校准、泛化性、可解释性、算法公平性、数据治理以及整合到临床工作流程中相关的挑战。大语言模型和联邦学习代表了新兴领域，但肾脏病学特异性证据仍然相对有限。人工智能在支持pre方面具有相当大的潜力。

abstract: Background Laboratory medicine underpins clinical decision-making across nearly every care setting. Clinical laboratory errors and delays can compromise diagnostic reliability and patient care. However, laboratory quality and operational data are commonly reviewed through separate manual workflows, limiting timely recognition of emerging problems across complementary data sources. Methods We developed and evaluated LabARIA (Laboratory Agentic Reasoning and Integrative Analytics), a multi-agent AI system for coordinated surveillance of specimen workflows, analytical quality control, and laboratory operations. abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence in diabetes care has historically relied on task-specific supervised learning, such as bespoke networks for retinopathy grading, kidney disease prediction, and glucose forecasting. The emergence of foundation models (FMs: large models pretrained on broad data, typically with self-supervision, and adapted to many downstream tasks) is displacing this paradigm across diabetes-relevant modalities: ophthalmic models such as RETFound, pretrained on 1.6 million retinal photographs, have been reported to outperform task-specific networks on retinopathy grading and systemic disease prediction, especially when labeled data are scarce; transformer-based time-series models are replacing long short-term memory (LSTM) pipelines for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) forecasting; clinical large language models (LLMs) such as Med-PaLM and GPT-4 attain expert-level scores on medical question-answering benchmarks; and generative models supply synthetic CGM and electronic health record (EHR) data. This review provides a critical, modality-organized synthesis of this transition. We (i) formalize a three-era taxonomy: rule-based risk scores (era I), task-specific deep learning (era II, 2016-2020), and foundation models (era III, from 2021), and map the diabetes literature onto it; (ii) survey foundation-model architectures, pretraining objectives, and adaptation strategies across retinal imaging, CGM, longitudinal EHR, and multimodal data; (iii) expose an evaluation crisis: benchmark contamination of LLM medical evaluations, a near-universal absence in the literature we reviewed of external and prospective validation for retinal and CGM foundation models, miscalibration under dataset shift, and, to our knowledge and within the reviewed literature (January 2016-December 2025; negative findings are time-sensitive), the absence of any randomized evaluation of a foundation model in a diabetes workflow; and (iv) analyze safety risks: hallucinated insulin-dosing advice, automation bias, inherited algorithmic inequity, and privacy exposure during adaptation. We conclude that the decisive open problem is no longer representation learning but grounded, calibrated, causally informed deployment, requiring contamination-resistant evaluation, prospective trials, and hybrid architectures coupling foundation-model representations with treatment-effect estimation.

abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has expanded the scale and speed of drug repurposing in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Transcriptomic signature matching, network-based systems pharmacology, real-world data pharmacoepidemiology and multi-omics machine learning have generated hundreds of candidate drugs, while repurposed agents account for 35% (56 of 158) of drugs and 42% (15 of 36) of Phase 3 agents in the 2026 AD pipeline. Clinical translation, however, remains unproven. Randomised trials of GLP-1 receptor agonists illustrate the gap between prioritisation and therapeutic proof: semaglutide did not slow clinical progression in evoke and evoke+, while liraglutide did not improve the primary FDG-PET endpoint in ELAD. We examine four complementary evidence domains, defining what each can and cannot establish, and position large language models as a cross-cutting tool for evidence synthesis and knowledge-graph reasoning rather than an independent source of biological evidence. Rather than cataloguing methods and candidates, we appraise leading drugs at the individual-molecule level and propose explicit criteria for progression from computational nomination to clinical testing. The framework defines seven requirements for clinical progression: disease-stage matching, adequate site-of-action exposure, including CNS exposure for central mechanisms, mechanistic validation in human-relevant models, biomarker-stratified trial design, convergence across independent evidence domains, causal inference with explicit boundary conditions, and mechanism-aligned endpoints with predefined stopping rules. AI has improved candidate prioritisation in AD, but clinical value will depend on converting ranked hypotheses into pharmacologically plausible and prospectively testable programmes.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] 人工智能（AI）扩大了阿尔茨海默病（AD）药物重定位的规模和速度。转录组特征匹配、基于网络的系统药理学、真实世界数据药物流行病学和多组学机器学习已产生数百种候选药物，而重定位药物在2026年AD研发管线中占药物的35%（56/158）和3期药物的42%（15/36）。然而，临床转化仍未经证实。GLP-1受体激动剂的随机试验说明了优先级排序与治疗证据之间的差距：司美格鲁肽在evoke和evoke+中未减缓临床进展，而利拉鲁肽在ELAD中未改善主要FDG-PET终点。我们审视四个互补的证据领域，界定每个领域能够和不能够确立什么，并将大语言模型定位为证据合成和知识图谱推理的跨领域工具，而非生物学证据的独立来源。我们不是对方法和候选药物进行编目，而是在单个分子层面评估领先药物，并提出从计算提名推进到临床测试的明确标准。该框架定义了临床推进的七项要求：疾病阶段匹配；足够的作用部位暴露，包括针对中枢机制的中枢神经系统（CNS）暴露；在与人相关的模型中进行机制验证；生物标志物分层试验设计；独立证据领域间的一致性；具有明确边界条件的因果推断；以及与机制一致的终点并预先设定停止规则。人工智能改善了AD候选药物的优先级排序，但临床价值将取决于能否将排序后的假设转化为药理学上合理且可前瞻性检验的研究方案。

abstract: [Clinical and experimental gastroenterology] Gastric cancer remains a major global health burden, and chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG) and gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) are important premalignant conditions. The risk of progression, however, varies considerably between individuals, making reliable risk stratification central to decisions on surveillance. Histological staging remains the most established approach. In a recent meta-analysis of prospective cohorts, Operative Link on Gastritis Assessment (OLGA) stages III-IV and OLGIM (Operative Link on Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Assessment) stages III-IV were associated with substantially higher risks of gastric cancer than stages 0-II, with risk ratios of 32.31 and 12.38, respectively. Endoscopic assessment adds information on the distribution of mucosal abnormalities and can improve biopsy targeting; an EGGIM score >4 has shown 95.7% sensitivity and 91.4% specificity for identifying OLGIM stages III-IV. Helicobacter pylori eradication reduces subsequent gastric cancer risk, but surveillance remains necessary in patients with advanced atrophy, extensive GIM, or previous gastric neoplasia. Serological biomarkers may help identify individuals who should undergo endoscopy, although variation in assay thresholds and population characteristics limits their use for definitive risk staging. Artificial intelligence is also being explored to improve diagnostic consistency. In a multicentre pathology study, a deep-learning model achieved external-test AUCs of 0.884 for intestinal metaplasia and 0.877 for atrophy. Current evidence therefore favours combining these approaches according to their clinical roles rather than treating them as interchangeable tools: histology remains the basis of risk staging, endoscopy refines mucosal assessment and biopsy, biomarkers are most useful for triage, and artificial intelligence may support interpretation. Whether such integrated strategies improve surveillance efficiency or clinical outcomes still requires prospective, externally validated studies.

abstract: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude faster than Monte Carlo sampling and returning calibrated risk intervals that direct chart review and selective imaging to borderline patients. Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, CE-Agent outperforms cardiovascular calculators in lung screening, exceeds the Pooled Cohort Equations on hard atherosclerotic events while correcting their 1.7-fold risk overestimation, and generalizes from a single hospital or CT scanner to external sites while lowering required sample sizes up to fivefold. Applied unchanged to lung cancer, CE-Agent matches established screening models with accurate calibration even when restricted to risk-factor directions alone, and pairing both predictions improves joint cardiopulmonary triage from a single screening visit.
zh_abstract: 常规胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）捕获肺、心脏和血管表型，这些表型共同对肺癌和心血管疾病进行分层，而这两者是肺癌筛查人群中的两大主要死因。然而，临床风险计算器孤立评估每种疾病并遗漏CT发现，而无约束机器学习会过拟合小型医院队列、学习受治疗和疾病混杂的风险方向，并在患者记录不完整时隐藏不确定性。在此，我们提出因果包络智能体（CE-Agent），一个两阶段框架，在观察任何结局之前，将同行评审的流行病学证据编译为对风险因素权重的显式约束，同时从队列数据估计局部基线风险和新增加的CT表型。在部署时，闭式不确定性传播可在每位患者数毫秒内处理缺失的临床或CT输入，运行速度比蒙特卡洛采样快两个数量级以上，并返回校准的风险区间，将病历审查和选择性影像检查导向临界患者。在来自33家美国医院的53,452名肺癌筛查参与者和6,814名多族裔成人中，CE-Agent在肺癌筛查中优于心血管计算器，在硬性动脉粥样硬化事件上超过汇总队列方程（Pooled Cohort Equations），同时纠正其1.7倍的风险高估，并从单一医院或CT扫描仪推广到外部站点，同时将所需样本量降低最多五倍。未经改动应用于肺癌时，CE-Agent即使仅限制于风险因素方向，也能以准确校准匹配既有筛查模型，并且将两种预测配对可改善单次筛查就诊的联合心肺分诊。

key_points: 整合T1/T1CE/T2/FLAIR四序列与肿瘤亚区分割
融合定量影像组学特征与临床变量，强调可解释性
通过消融实验评估各模块贡献，采用多种评价指标
reason: 有方法新意与消融对比的预印本，未见外部验证
abstract: Accurate prediction of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation status is essential for glioma diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning. Although recent deep learning approaches have demonstrated promising performance, many rely on whole-brain feature extraction and provide limited interpretability. This study proposes a tumour-aware multimodal framework for explainable, non-invasive prediction of IDH mutation status from multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The proposed framework integrates four MRI sequences (T1, T1CE, T2, and FLAIR), tumour subregion segmentation, quantitative radiomic descriptors, and clinical information within a unified deep learning architecture. An ablation study was conducted to evaluate the contribution of tumour-aware learning, radiomic features, and clinical variables. Model performance was assessed using multiple complementary evaluation metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, balanced accuracy, receiver operating characteristic analysis, confusion matrix evaluation, and Grad-CAM visualisation. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed multimodal framework consistently outperformed the baseline MRI-only model, with the Clinical Fusion model achieving the strongest overall predictive performance. The integration of tumour-aware learning, radiomic descriptors, and clinical information progressively improved classification performance, while Grad-CAM visualisations indicated that the model predominantly focused on biologically relevant tumour regions. These findings suggest that tumour-aware multimodal feature integration enables accurate, interpretable, and non-invasive molecular profiling of gliomas and provides a promising foundation for future clinical decision support in precision neuro-oncology.
zh_abstract: 准确预测异柠檬酸脱氢酶（isocitrate dehydrogenase，IDH）突变状态对于胶质瘤的诊断、预后和治疗计划至关重要。尽管近期深度学习方法已表现出有前景的性能，但许多方法依赖全脑特征提取，且可解释性有限。本研究提出一种肿瘤感知的多模态框架，用于基于多参数磁共振成像（magnetic resonance imaging，MRI）对IDH突变状态进行可解释、无创预测。该框架在统一的深度学习架构中整合了四种MRI序列（T1、T1CE、T2和FLAIR）、肿瘤亚区分割、定量放射组学描述符和临床信息。进行了消融研究，以评估肿瘤感知学习、放射组学特征和临床变量的贡献。使用多种互补的评估指标评估模型性能，包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、平衡准确率、受试者工作特征分析、混淆矩阵评估和Grad-CAM可视化。实验结果表明，所提出的多模态框架始终优于仅MRI的基线模型，其中临床融合模型取得了最强的总体预测性能。肿瘤感知学习、放射组学描述符和临床信息的整合逐步改善了分类性能，而Grad-CAM可视化表明模型主要关注生物学相关的肿瘤区域。这些发现表明，肿瘤感知的多模态特征整合能够实现胶质瘤准确、可解释且无创的分子谱分析，并为精准神经肿瘤学未来的临床决策支持提供了有前景的基础。

title: Cracks in Embeddings: Robustness and Stability of JEPA-Based Chest X-Ray Representations
zh_title: JEPA胸部X光表征的鲁棒性与稳定性缺陷
summary: 预印本在6项扰动测试下评估4个JEPA胸部X光编码器，发现对抗攻击与图像退化会显著损害表征与AUROC。
key_points: 基于78468张NIH胸片训练4个编码器
最差情况下AUROC下降约0.12
尝试对抗微调等两种预测器训练方式
reason: 有新意的鲁棒性评测预印本，但无外部临床验证，未超预印本档
abstract: Self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models are increasingly used for medical imaging, however there is a limited understanding about robustness of these models toward real-world image changes. We test four JEPA-based chest X-ray encoders, trained on 78,468 NIH ChestX-ray14 images, under six tests: two black-box adversarial attacks (SPSA, Boundary Attack), three image corruptions (Gaussian noise, brightness shift, contrast shift), and a label-scarcity test, measuring embedding change and classification AUROC. These perturbations cause severe, model-dependent damage: encoder-level Cosine Similarity drops as low as 0.33, and AUROC falls by as much as 0.12 in the worst case (I-JEPA under the Boundary Test). We test two ways of training the small predictor on top of each frozen encoder to address this. Adversarial fine-tuning, trained on clean and perturbed images together, raises embedding consistency above 0.97 in nearly every case and improves AUROC, relative to the same perturbed baseline, for most models, with the largest gain of $+0.10$ on I-JEPA. A Vector-Quantized codebook method, trained only on clean images and evaluated on perturbed test images for the first time, instead degrades under distortion for all four models, most noticeably for I-JEPA ($-0.15$ AUROC on average), showing that its discrete bottleneck alone does not provide the robustness that comes from training on perturbed data directly.
zh_abstract: 自监督联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture，JEPA）模型正越来越多地用于医学影像，然而人们对其在真实世界图像变化下的鲁棒性了解有限。我们在六项测试下测试了四个基于JEPA的胸部X线编码器（在78,468张NIH ChestX-ray14图像上训练）：两种黑盒对抗攻击（SPSA、Boundary Attack）、三种图像损坏（高斯噪声、亮度偏移、对比度偏移）以及一项标签稀缺性测试，测量嵌入变化和分类AUROC。这些扰动造成严重的、依赖模型的损害：编码器层面的余弦相似度（Cosine Similarity）最低降至0.33，AUROC在最坏情况下（Boundary Test下的I-JEPA）下降多达0.12。我们测试了两种在每个冻结编码器之上训练小型预测器的方法来应对这一问题。对抗微调（在干净图像和扰动图像上共同训练）在几乎所有情况下将嵌入一致性提高到0.97以上，并且对于大多数模型，相对于相同的扰动基线提高了AUROC，其中在I-JEPA上增益最大，为$+0.10$。一种向量量化码本方法（Vector-Quantized codebook method）仅在干净图像上训练，并首次在扰动测试图像上评估，却在所有四个模型中都因失真而性能下降，最明显的是I-JEPA（平均AUROC为$-0.15$），表明其离散瓶颈本身并不能提供直接使用扰动数据训练所带来的鲁棒性。

title: PADSNet: Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network with Biomechanical Priors for Laryngeal Lesion Classification
zh_title: PADSNet：融合生物力学先验的双流喉部病变分类网络
summary: 预印本提出物理感知双流网络，结合小波注意力与可解释生物力学指标分类喉部病变。
key_points: 针对喉部病变类间视觉差异细微的问题
小波注意力模块融合空间纹理与频率表征
从声带振动动态中提取可解释生物力学指标
reason: 预印本新方法，有明确设计但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Precise classification of laryngeal lesions is clinically crucial yet highly challenging, as inter-class visual differences are often subtle. While abnormalities in vocal fold vibratory dynamics provide complementary discriminative information, existing deep learning models predominantly rely on visual appearance and lack explicit mechanisms for modeling clinically meaningful vibratory dynamics. To address this, we propose PADSNet, a Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network for laryngeal lesion classification that integrates visual representations with explicit biomechanical reasoning. Specifically, a Wavelet-Attention Enhancement Module (WAEM) is designed to bridge the spectral-semantic gap, enabling complementary learning of spatial texture and dynamic frequency representations. Meanwhile, a Knowledge Computing Module (KCM) extracts interpretable biomechanical indices from temporal glottal distance waveforms, including indicators of mobility, symmetry, glottal closure, and vibration stability. These descriptors are subsequently incorporated into a Physics-Aware Gating Module (PAGM) as biomechanical priors to adaptively recalibrate visual feature toward pathology-relevant vibratory patterns. Extensive experiments on a clinical dataset demonstrate that PADSNet achieves an accuracy of 0.8452, an F1-score of 0.8090, a sensitivity of 0.7953, and a specificity of 0.8866. These results indicate that explicitly integrating biomechanical priors with deep visual representations provides a more accurate, robust, and clinically interpretable framework for automated laryngeal lesion classification.
zh_abstract: 喉部病变的精确分类在临床上至关重要，但极具挑战性，因为类间视觉差异往往很细微。虽然声带振动动力学的异常提供了互补的判别信息，但现有深度学习模型主要依赖视觉外观，缺乏对具有临床意义的振动动力学进行建模的显式机制。为解决这一问题，我们提出PADSNet，一种用于喉部病变分类的物理感知双流网络，它将视觉表征与显式生物力学推理相结合。具体而言，设计了小波注意力增强模块（WAEM），以弥合频谱-语义鸿沟，实现空间纹理与动态频率表征的互补学习。同时，知识计算模块（KCM）从时间声门距离波形中提取可解释的生物力学指标，包括活动度、对称性、声门闭合和振动稳定性等指标。这些描述符随后被纳入物理感知门控模块（PAGM），作为生物力学先验，以自适应地将视觉特征重新校准至病理相关振动模式。在临床数据集上进行的大量实验表明，PADSNet达到0.8452的准确率、0.8090的F1分数、0.7953的灵敏度和0.8866的特异度。这些结果表明，将生物力学先验与深度视觉表征显式整合，为自动化喉部病变分类提供了一个更准确、稳健且具有临床可解释性的框架。

title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
zh_title: 大基因面板空间转录组预测框架GeneFlow
summary: 提出GeneFlow框架，用流匹配生成建模与多模态融合，直接从组织图像预测大面板空间基因表达。
key_points: 统一流匹配生成建模与结构化多模态融合
组织学与基因分词器编码形态及跨基因互作
直接预测空间基因表达，面向大基因面板
reason: 预印本新方法，面向大基因面板但验证信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow
zh_abstract: 从组织学预测空间转录组学（ST）旨在直接从组织图像推断空间分辨的基因表达谱。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，目前通常通过复杂模型架构、额外输入和复杂训练程序来解决，同时仍局限于固定的小基因面板。这引出一个自然的问题：是否存在一种用于大面板ST预测的高效方法？在此，我们提出 GeneFlow，一个更简单但有效的大规模空间基因表达预测框架，它将流匹配生成建模与结构化多模态融合统一起来。具体而言，GeneFlow首先通过组织学分词器和基因分词器，在空间斑点中编码组织学形态和跨基因相互作用。该模型直接预测空间基因表达，而不是中间速度场，同时以基于速度的流匹配目标进行训练。我们表明，即使不依赖重型生成流程，GeneFlow在多个ST基准上达到最先进性能，在1000个基因预测中提升高达56.8%。大量实验进一步表明，GeneFlow产生具有生物学意义的斑点图谱，同时将计算成本降低几个数量级，从而提高效率和可扩展性，特别是在临床环境中。我们认为 GeneFlow 为利用广泛可用的组织学图像进行下游生物学发现提供了机会。代码可在：https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow 获取

title: Electrocardiographic Imaging via Posterior Sampling under Operator Discrepancy
zh_title: 考虑算子差异的心电成像后验采样
summary: 提出OpDis-PS扩散后验采样器，建模ECGI前向算子差异并用于心表面电位重建。
key_points: ECGI是由体表电位重建心表面电位的病态逆问题
呼吸、体位和皮下脂肪导致结构化算子差异
方法学习信号相关差异并修正前向算子
reason: 预印本新方法，针对ECGI逆问题但无临床验证，值得一看档
abstract: Electrocardiographic imaging (ECGI) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface potentials, an ill-posed inverse problem. Diffusion posterior samplers combine a learned prior with an explicit forward operator that they assume to be accurate. In ECGI this operator is only an estimate, because the body changes with respiration and posture, and body composition such as subcutaneous fat is rarely known for an individual patient. The resulting operator discrepancy is structured and depends on the heart signal. We introduce OpDis-PS, a diffusion posterior sampler that models this discrepancy instead of treating it as signal-independent noise. OpDis-PS learns how the discrepancy depends on the signal, folds this into a corrected forward operator, and reconstructs with a fixed prior across all operator conditions. We study two realistic sources of discrepancy, changing lung conductivity and an added subcutaneous-fat layer. Across both, OpDis-PS reconstructs more accurately than classical regularization and learned predictors, with its largest gains on held-out cardiac pathologies.
zh_abstract: 心电图成像（electrocardiographic imaging, ECGI）从体表电位重建心脏表面电位，这是一个不适定逆问题。扩散后验采样器将学习到的先验与一个显式前向算子结合，并假定该算子是准确的。在ECGI中，该算子只是一个估计，因为身体会随呼吸和体位变化，而皮下脂肪等身体组成对单个患者而言很少已知。由此产生的算子差异是有结构的，并取决于心脏信号。我们提出OpDis-PS，这是一种扩散后验采样器，它对这种差异进行建模，而不是将其视为与信号无关的噪声。OpDis-PS学习该差异如何依赖于信号，将其纳入校正后的前向算子，并在所有算子条件下使用固定先验进行重建。我们研究了两类现实的差异来源：肺电导率变化和增加的皮下脂肪层。在这两种情况下，OpDis-PS的重建都比经典正则化方法和学习型预测器更准确，并且在留出的心脏病理数据上增益最大。

title: Continuous Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Using PPG From Methods to Clinical Translation
zh_title: PPG无袖带连续血压估计综述
summary: 综述PPG无袖带血压估计的完整测量链，涵盖生理机制、特征、机器学习方法、数据集、校准与临床转化。
key_points: PPG不直接测动脉压，需由波形或脉搏时序推断
血管张力、动脉僵硬度、接触与运动影响估计
综述覆盖校准、验证、部署、偏倚与临床转化
reason: 预印本综述，覆盖方法与临床转化但无原始验证，值得一看档
abstract: Continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring could improve hypertension management by capturing changes that intermittent cuff measurements miss. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely explored for cuffless BP estimation because optical sensors are inexpensive, wearable, and already present in many consumer and clinical devices. PPG, however, does not measure arterial pressure: BP is inferred from waveform characteristics or pulse timing, which also depend on vascular tone, arterial stiffness, sensor contact, motion, and individual physiology. This survey reviews PPG-based cuffless BP estimation along the full measurement chain, covering physiological mechanisms, waveform features, pulse arrival time (PAT), pulse transit time (PTT), machine-learning methods, datasets, calibration, validation, deployment, bias, and clinical translation. Studies are assessed by the strength of evidence they provide rather than by reported error alone, with particular attention to subject and temporal leakage, dataset imbalance, calibration dependence and drift, motion artifacts, and the gap between benchmark accuracy and reliable real-world measurement. The review finds that progress depends on more than better prediction algorithms. Future work should prioritize physiologically informed models, diverse longitudinal datasets, transparent reporting of calibration requirements and failure rates, stronger evaluation protocols, and studies that demonstrate practical value in clinical care.
zh_abstract: 连续血压（BP）监测可通过捕获间歇性袖带测量遗漏的变化来改善高血压管理。光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）因光学传感器廉价、可穿戴且已存在于许多消费级和临床设备中，被广泛探索用于无袖带BP估计。然而，PPG并不测量动脉压：BP是根据波形特征或脉搏时序推断的，而这些也取决于血管张力、动脉僵硬度、传感器接触、运动和个体生理。本综述沿完整测量链回顾基于PPG的无袖带BP估计，涵盖生理机制、波形特征、脉搏到达时间（PAT）、脉搏传导时间（PTT）、机器学习方法、数据集、校准、验证、部署、偏倚和临床转化。研究按其所提供证据的强度而非仅按报告误差进行评估，特别关注受试者泄漏和时间泄漏、数据集不平衡、校准依赖与漂移、运动伪影，以及基准准确性与可靠真实世界测量之间的差距。综述发现，进展不仅取决于更好的预测算法。未来工作应优先考虑生理学知情模型、多样化纵向数据集、校准需求和失败率的透明报告、更强的评估方案，以及证明临床护理实际价值的研究。

title: A thorough review on Deep Learning approaches to 2D-to-3D Registration in Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像2D-3D配准深度学习综述
summary: 该预印本综述系统梳理深度学习用于医学影像2D-to-3D配准的方法、架构与域适应策略。
key_points: 聚焦术前3D与术中2D影像对齐
回顾流程设计、架构创新与域适应
指出传统优化方法在非凸目标等方面受限
reason: 综述类预印本，无新实验或外部验证，属有信息量综述档
abstract: 2D-to-3D image registration is a key component for several medical imaging purposes such as intraoperative guidance, enabling the alignment between preoperative 3D volumes and real-time 2D images. While conventional optimisation-based methods often struggle with non-convex objectives, sensitivity to initialisation, and high computational demands, deep learning (DL) has emerged as a promising alternative, offering improved alignment robustness and the potential for real-time performance. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of DL frameworks developed to address the challenges inherent in 2D-to-3D registration. We first outline how core concepts of DL are adapted to the registration problem. We then examine recent methodological advancements from multiple perspectives, including pipeline design, architectural innovations, and domain adaptation strategies. Particular attention is given to quantitative metrics, highlighting how performance is defined and measured across studies. Across the 41 included studies, we find that direct regression is the most common pipeline (23 studies, against 18 iterative ones), that hybrid CNN-attention architectures are gaining ground, and that research remains heavily concentrated on X-ray-to-CT registration. We conclude by identifying the absence of per-case uncertainty estimation and the strong neglect of temporal or sequential modelling as the two methodological gaps most consequential for clinical readiness, and discuss state-space models as a way to add temporal memory within intraoperative latency budgets. Further opportunities lie in more principled domain adaptation and in the integration of foundation models for representation learning.
zh_abstract: 2D到3D图像配准是若干医学成像用途（如术中引导）的关键组成部分，可实现术前3D体数据与实时2D图像之间的对齐。传统基于优化的方法常难以处理非凸目标、对初始化敏感且计算需求高，而深度学习（DL）已成为有前景的替代方案，提供更高的对齐稳健性和实时性能潜力。本综述对为解决2D到3D配准固有挑战而开发的DL框架进行了全面分析。我们首先概述DL核心概念如何适配配准问题。随后从多个视角审视近期方法学进展，包括流程设计、架构创新和域适应策略。特别关注定量指标，强调各研究如何定义和测量性能。在纳入的41项研究中，我们发现直接回归是最常见的流程（23项研究，对比18项迭代方法），混合CNN-注意力架构正在兴起，且研究仍高度集中于X射线到CT配准。最后，我们指出缺乏逐病例不确定性估计以及对时间或序列建模的明显忽视是对临床就绪性影响最大的两个方法学缺口，并讨论状态空间模型作为一种在术中延迟预算内加入时间记忆的方式。进一步的机会在于更原则化的域适应以及整合基础模型进行表示学习。

title: The Potential of Large Language Models in Gynecologic Oncology Telephone Triage.
zh_title: 大模型用于妇科肿瘤电话分诊的探索
summary: 以20个虚构病例比较LLM与三位妇科肿瘤专家UKONS分级，属小样本探索性评估。
key_points: 构建20个妇科肿瘤治疗毒性虚构病例
三位顾问医师独立分级并达成共识作为参照
病例以单轮提问方式输入LLM，未做真实临床验证
reason: 仅20例虚构病例、无真实数据与外部验证，属小样本增量
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Introduction: Nurse-led telephone triage, frequently guided by the United Kingdom Oncology Nursing Society (UKONS) tool, is a cornerstone of supportive oncology care, yet the appropriateness of triage decisions varies across settings. Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in medical communication but remain unvalidated for autonomous clinical decision-making, particularly in gynecologic oncology, where remote and telephone-based care pose distinct challenges. Methods and Materials: Twenty fictitious case vignettes representing common treatment-related toxicities in gynecologic oncology were developed. Three board-certified gynecologic consultants independently assigned UKONS Red-Amber-Green (RAG) triage categories, reaching unanimous consensus that served as the reference standard. Vignettes were submitted verbatim, as single-turn queries with no follow-up prompting, to three publicly available LLMs (OpenEvidence, ChatGPT, Google Gemini). LLM responses were mapped to RAG categories and compared descriptively against the reference standard, stratified by treatment type and platform. Results: All three LLMs achieved 100% concordance with the reference standard for all Red cases across both treatment groups, with no high-acuity case downgraded to self-care. Discrepancies clustered at lower-acuity boundaries. In the chemotherapy-alone group, errors were limited to omission of an explicit 24-h follow-up window for 1 Amber-rated complaints. In the combined group, all LLMs over-triaged intermediate-risk complaints toward immediate or same-day evaluation; low-risk complaints showed more variable over-triage. Conclusions: LLMs identified unambiguous emergent gynecologic oncology symptoms, preserving the UKONS safety floor, but showed relatively reduced precision and a conservative over-triage bias at lower-acuity margins, especially in the combined-therapy collective. These findings support a supervised, adjunctive role for LLMs, rather than autonomous deployment, pending prospective validation.

title: Artificial intelligence and clinical reasoning - a qualitative study with general practice trainees in Germany.

abstract: [BMC medical education] General practitioners face high complexity in clinical decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) may support clinical reasoning, but their impact on decision-making processes and postgraduate medical training remains unclear. This qualitative study aims to explore General Practice (GP) trainee's use of LLMs in clinical reasoning and their educational needs. GP trainees were recruited and interviewed with semi-structured interview-guide. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed qualitatively. Seventeen GP trainees participated (mean interview duration: 38 min; range: 21-63 min). AI was perceived as a tool to augment and accelerate clinical decision-making, while potential risks of deskilling were identified. Participants reported a lack of structured AI education and expressed a need for its integration into postgraduate training. Participants perceived AI primarily as a supportive tool that can complement clinical reasoning and improve access to medical knowledge. At the same time, they identified potential risks, including overreliance on AI-generated information and possible effects on the development of clinical expertise. These findings suggest that postgraduate medical training should address AI-related competencies, including critical appraisal, ethical responsibility and appropriate integration of AI into clinical decision-making. AI is already part of clinical practice among GP trainees, offering opportunities to support learning and clinical reasoning while raising concerns about overreliance and critical appraisal. Postgraduate medical training in GP should therefore incorporate structured AI competencies to ensure responsible, reflective and patient-centered use of AI.

abstract: [Medicine] The medical-education literature on ChatGPT has grown rapidly since 2023, but bibliometric patterns vary with database coverage, indexing fields, and the boundary used to define educational relevance. We examined publication growth, collaboration, and thematic development and assessed whether the leading patterns were stable under a stricter topic definition. Web of Science Core Collection (WoSCC) and PubMed were searched on September 5, 2026; the PubMed publication-date filter extended through September 4, 2026. WoSCC supported citation- and Author Keyword-based science mapping, whereas PubMed provided a complementary Medical Subject Headings-based view. The expanded corpora contained 665 WoSCC and 1106 PubMed records, with strict topic-specific subsets of 532 and 898 records, respectively. Bibliometrix/R, VOSviewer, CiteSpace, and Microsoft Excel were used for descriptive bibliometrics, collaboration networks, thematic mapping, multiple correspondence analysis, keyword co-occurrence, Trend Topics, burst detection, and journal mapping. Data from 2026 were treated as partial-year observations. WoSCC publication output increased from 66 records in 2023 to 169 in 2024 and 242 in 2025; 188 records were indexed during the partial 2026 period. The United States had the largest corresponding-author output, and Sichuan University was the leading displayed affiliation. The keyword structure centered on medical education, ChatGPT, artificial intelligence, and large language models. CiteSpace identified 9 keyword clusters, including medical education, large language models, medical students, generative artificial intelligence, prompt engineering, clinical decision-making, and patient education. Recently emerging terms included DeepSeek, clinical reasoning, and anatomy education. Author Keyword rankings were highly concordant between the expanded and strict WoSCC datasets (Spearman ρ = 0.973, P < .001). ChatGPT-related medical-education research expanded substantially after 2023 and diversified across assessment, clinical reasoning, educational applications, and broader LLM-related themes. The leading WoSCC keyword structure remained stable under the stricter topic definition. WoSCC and PubMed captured different bibliographic features and are best interpreted as complementary sources.

title: Inferring single-cell gene expression profiles from multicellular spatial transcriptomics data with st2sc

abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables the quantitative measurement of gene expression within tissue sections but is currently limited in spatial resolution, as each spot aggregates signals from multiple cells. Recovering single-cell gene expression profiles from these multicellular measurements requires two steps: explicit identification of individual cells and accurate estimation of per-gene expression. While existing methods have demonstrated the feasibility of recovering single-cell expression profiles, accurately estimating gene-level expression for individual cells remains an important challenge. To address this challenge, we propose st2sc (Spatial Transcriptomics to Single-Cell), an end-to-end framework for inferring single-cell gene profiles from multicellular ST data. st2sc introduces a novel Attention Gradient Flow Tracking (AGFT) algorithm that extracts attention maps from a Vision-Gene Transformer to identify candidate cell instances without predefined background constraints. The detected instances are then used by a set of regressors trained under a multiple-instance, multiple-target regression setting to predict precise single-cell gene expression counts. Comprehensive evaluations on synthetic and Visium-like datasets demonstrate that st2sc significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accurately segmenting cellular instances and predicting gene counts. The method can further resolve contested 2um bin in Visium HD. Application to human IPF lung showed the model can recover the subtype marker level analysis. This advancement further improves single-cell resolution analysis in spatial transcriptomics, facilitating more accurate downstream biological analyses.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）能够对组织切片内的基因表达进行定量测量，但目前受限于空间分辨率，因为每个spot聚集了来自多个细胞的信号。从这些多细胞测量中恢复单细胞基因表达谱需要两个步骤：明确识别单个细胞和准确估计每个基因的表达。尽管现有方法已证明恢复单细胞表达谱的可行性，但准确估计单个细胞的基因水平表达仍是一个重要挑战。为解决这一挑战，我们提出st2sc（Spatial Transcriptomics to Single-Cell），一个从多细胞ST数据推断单细胞基因谱的端到端框架。st2sc引入一种新的注意力梯度流跟踪（AGFT）算法，从视觉-基因Transformer中提取注意力图，以在无预定义背景约束的情况下识别候选细胞实例。检测到的实例随后由一组在多重实例、多重目标回归设置下训练的回归器使用，以预测精确的单细胞基因表达计数。在合成和类Visium数据集上的综合评估表明，st2sc在准确分割细胞实例和预测基因计数方面显著优于最先进方法。该方法可进一步解析Visium HD中有争议的2um bin。应用于人类IPF肺时，模型能够恢复亚型标志物水平分析。这一进展进一步改善了空间转录组学中的单细胞分辨率分析，促进更准确的下游生物学分析。

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Deep learning has become an important computational approach in dermatology because it enables automated segmentation and classification of skin lesions. Manual dermoscopic analysis is time-consuming and depends on specialist expertise, with potential inter-observer variability. There is a need to develop reliable computer-aided diagnostic tools. This structured narrative review covers journal papers published mainly from 2018 to 2026 on skin lesion analysis with focus on image preprocessing, benchmark datasets, conventional machine learning approaches, convolutional neural networks, U-Net architectures, transfer learning approaches, Vision Transformers, attention-based models, ensemble solutions, and hybrid segmentation-classification systems. Building on present reviews covering individual tasks as well as broader segmentation-classification pipelines, the present work provides a critical development-to-deployment analysis connecting dataset characteristics, preprocessing, segmentation, classification, evaluation, explainability, robustness, fairness, computational requirements, and clinical applicability. The paper describes widely used evaluation metrics and explains why results obtained across different datasets, partitions, and experimental setups should not be directly compared. Major open problems include class imbalance, data bias, domain shift, limited representation of diverse skin tones, inadequate external validation, computational requirements, and limited explainability of efficient models. Emerging trends such as self-supervised learning, Transformers, foundation models, explainable AI, federated learning, and multi-modal clinical data are reviewed as well. The review offers practical advice to researchers and clinicians on how to approach the preprocessing, segmentation, classification, and evaluation of skin lesions and highlights priorities in developing clinically reliable skin lesion analysis systems.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 深度学习已成为皮肤病学中的重要计算方法，因为它能够实现皮肤病变的自动分割和分类。手动皮肤镜分析耗时且依赖专科专业知识，并存在观察者间变异性的可能。需要开发可靠的计算机辅助诊断工具。这篇结构化叙述性综述涵盖主要发表于2018年至2026年的关于皮肤病变分析的期刊论文，重点关注图像预处理、基准数据集、传统机器学习方法、卷积神经网络、U-Net架构、迁移学习方法、视觉Transformer（Vision Transformers）、基于注意力的模型、集成解决方案以及分割-分类混合系统。在现有综述分别涵盖单项任务以及更广泛的分割-分类流程的基础上，本工作提供了一项批判性的从开发到部署分析，将数据集特征、预处理、分割、分类、评估、可解释性、稳健性、公平性、计算需求和临床适用性联系起来。本文描述了广泛使用的评估指标，并解释了为何在不同数据集、划分和实验设置下获得的结果不应直接比较。主要开放问题包括类别不平衡、数据偏倚、域偏移、不同肤色代表性有限、外部验证不足、计算需求以及高效模型的可解释性有限。还综述了自监督学习、Transformer、基础模型、可解释AI、联邦学习和多模态临床数据等新兴趋势。本综述为研究人员和临床医生提供了关于如何处理皮肤病变的预处理、分割、分类和评估的实用建议，并强调了开发临床可靠的皮肤病变分析系统的优先事项。

title: QCAP-VQA: Question-Conditioned Capped Prior-Mass Supervision for Medical Visual Question Answering
zh_title: QCAP-VQA：问题条件化解剖先验监督
summary: 提出以问题条件化区域先验约束部分注意力头，并用SLAKE结构框评估注意力，准确率与无空间监督基线持平。

abstract: Medical visual question answering models can answer correctly without attending to the anatomy that the question names. Automatic region priors allow spatial supervision without expert masks, but they are noisy, and it is unclear how strongly they should shape attention and how their effect should be verified. We present QCAP-VQA, which supervises a subset of cross-attention heads with a question-conditioned prior built from ranked segmentation proposals. Its capped prior-mass objective penalizes insufficient attention inside the prior only below a threshold. We evaluate attention against SLAKE structure boxes that play no role in training, separating attention on the named anatomy from how attention shifts between questions about the same image. QCAP-VQA matches the accuracy of a baseline without spatial supervision (84.26% vs. 84.23%), and every evaluated prior-supervised model places more attention on the annotated structures. Over a 64-fold range of regularization strength, the capped objective keeps prior mass between 0.67 and 0.77, whereas a pooled region-mass objective drives it to 0.97 and loses accuracy. The cost lies in question conditioning: as the constraint widens or strengthens, attention shifts agree less with the expert-defined contrast. Across 13 configurations, prior-referenced and expert-referenced evaluation rank the models in largely opposite order (Spearman correlation of -0.87), and the capped models it favors track the prior's own errors. Because clinical use of medical visual question answering requires answers grounded in the queried anatomy, supervision from automatic priors should be judged against independent anatomical references.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答模型可以在不关注问题所指解剖结构的情况下正确作答。自动区域先验允许在没有专家掩码的情况下进行空间监督，但它们是有噪声的，目前尚不清楚它们应在多大程度上塑造注意力，以及其效果应如何验证。我们提出 QCAP-VQA，它使用由排序后的分割候选构建的问题条件先验来监督一部分交叉注意力头。其带上限的先验质量目标仅在低于阈值时惩罚先验内部注意力不足。我们对照 SLAKE 结构框评估注意力，这些结构框在训练中不起作用，从而将针对所指解剖结构的注意力与注意力在关于同一图像的不同问题之间如何转移区分开来。QCAP-VQA 的准确率与无空间监督的基线相当（84.26% 对 84.23%），并且每个被评估的先验监督模型都将更多注意力放在标注结构上。在64倍的正则化强度范围内，带上限目标将先验质量保持在0.67至0.77之间，而池化区域质量目标将其推高至0.97并损失准确率。代价在于问题条件化：随着约束扩大或增强，注意力转移与专家定义的对比之间的一致性降低。在13种配置中，基于先验的评估和基于专家的评估对模型的排序在很大程度上相反（Spearman相关系数为-0.87），并且它所偏好的带上限模型会追随先验自身的错误。由于医学视觉问答的临床使用要求答案基于所询问的解剖结构，来自自动先验的监督应依据独立的解剖参考来评判。

abstract: Self-supervised learning aims to learn meaningful representations from unlabeled data, potentially allowing models to capture subtle anatomical variations across patients and reduce the amount of labeled data needed. Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) learns by predicting target-region representations from visible context rather than reconstructing pixels. However, its uniform target placement does not account for the anatomical structure of retinal OCT, where retinal tissue occupies only part of each B-scan. We investigate anatomy-guided target selection using image intensity and predicted retinal segmentation while retaining the I-JEPA architecture and latent prediction objective. We compare anatomy-guided rectangular targets, anatomy-shaped targets and coverage-constrained placement with uniform masking, and evaluate the learned representations using linear probing for glaucoma classification on FairVision. We found that rectangular targets guided by image intensity achieved the highest linear-probe AUC in our comparisons. We show that anatomically meaningful target selection is promising for retinal OCT representation learning, while greater anatomical specificity did not consistently improve performance.
